summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Parça/Depo/Sarf Yönetimi (Parts/Inventory Management) features. All 33 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all major features including Parts List page with inventory/movements tabs, Add Part dialog, Stock In/Out dialogs, Low Stock Alerts, Search/Filter functionality, and Work Order Parts tab with usage/reservation features.

action_items: Consider adding aria-describedby to Dialog components for better accessibility
critical_code_review_comments: All Parts/Inventory APIs are properly implemented with validation
Stock movement types correctly update quantities (in/out/purchase/scrap/adjustment)
Part reservations properly track reserved_quantity on parts
Low stock alerts correctly calculate available quantity (quantity - reserved_quantity)
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test parts (SFP, PSU, Cable, etc.) with various categories, stock movements (in/out/purchase/scrap/adjustment), part reservations, and part usage records during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Parça/Depo/Sarf Yönetimi features are working correctly. Backend tests cover: Parts CRUD, Stock Movements (in/out/purchase/scrap/adjustment), Part Reservations (create/use/cancel), Part Usage, Low Stock Alerts, Serialized Parts, Part Returns. Frontend tests verified: Parts List page with Envanter/Stok Hareketleri tabs, Add Part dialog with all fields, Stock In/Out dialogs, Low Stock Alerts section, Search/Filter functionality, Work Order Parts tab with Kullan/Rezerve Et buttons.

parts_list_page.stock_in_dialog: PASS - Shows transaction type dropdown, quantity input, description textarea
parts_list_page.stock_out_dialog: PASS - Same as stock in, disabled when no available stock
parts_list_page.low_stock_alerts: PASS - Shows alert badges with part number and current/min stock
parts_list_page.search_functionality: PASS - Filters parts by name, part number, or brand
parts_list_page.category_filter: PASS - Dropdown shows all categories (SFP/GBIC, PSU, Kablo, etc.)
parts_list_page.stock_filter: PASS - Dropdown shows Tümü/Stokta/Düşük Stok/Stok Yok options

work_order_parts_tab.parts_tab: PASS - Shows Parçalar tab with count in Work Order Detail
work_order_parts_tab.add_part_dialog: PASS - Shows Parça Ekle / Rezerve Et dialog with part select, quantity input

backend_apis.POST /api/parts: PASS - Creates parts with all fields, validates duplicate part numbers

backend_apis.POST /api/stock-movements: PASS - Creates stock movements, updates part quantities correctly
